findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: high-risk design now bypasses the previously required product workflow before choosing boundaries and fallbacks, but the packet omits that workflow’s gate and the canonical security-question rules. The visible resilience contract cannot establish that every former design-time obligation remains covered, particularly across the broader privacy and high-impact-AI cases.
findings.smallest_fix: Supply bounded excerpts of the deferred gate and canonical security rules, and map each design-time obligation to the retained design checks.

findings.failure_path: Evidence gap: the packet supplies aggregate outcomes without the scoring protocol or checks for first-owner ordering, completed security answers, defaults, handoffs and gate re-entry before implementation. Loading architecture eventually and including a security heading could pass while these requirements fail. Candidate-bound routing-gate, make test, heavy-regression and sanitization results required by AGENTS.md are also absent.
findings.smallest_fix: Include bounded regression evidence that detects these violations, the scoring/exclusion criteria, and current-candidate results or explicit skips for the required repository checks.

findings.failure_path: The loaded-byte gate is reported as passing even though direct entry-file reads count as zero and reference reads are omitted. Changing the loading mechanism can therefore produce a passing result without reducing actual loaded bytes. Lower cache-write tokens do not establish that byte threshold or the subsequent assertion that context definitely shrank.
findings.smallest_fix: Mark the byte gate inconclusive until comparable accounting includes direct reads and references. Keep the observed token decrease descriptive and qualify the context-reduction conclusion.

findings.failure_path: The regex totals establish role-mention frequency, not that agents replaced skill names during final polishing or that increased architecture loading caused the count to double. No ordered output evidence or comparison isolating that cause is supplied, yet this causal account justifies the new handoff rule.
findings.smallest_fix: Label the proposed mechanism as a hypothesis, or provide bounded traces and comparison evidence supporting the attribution.

challenge_focus: Review of new behavior added after an earlier review and challenge of this branch. New since then: (1) a design-only backend request now starts at software-architecture and does not load product-rd-workflow first, including on high-risk surfaces, with product-rd and its high-risk gate taking over before implementation or launch; (2) the design-time security questions are answered by the designer and not put to the requester; (3) open points get a stated default, handoffs name a stage and never a person or role, and no approver or sign-off is invented. Check for a safety obligation that the deferred product-rd gate carried at design time and nothing now carries, contradictions with other rules in the changed files, and whether plan sections 11.5-11.6 state only what the recorded numbers support.
